column1: # Reviewed exceptions to the licence-header rules (check_license_headers.py).
# Columns, separated by TABs: path, the SPDX expression the file's header
# must say, and the reason. An exception replaces the location rule and the
# deprecated-identifier rule for that one file. A first-party file derived
# from kernel code keeps the kernel's identifier (GPL-2.0-only, or
# GPL-2.0-only WITH Linux-syscall-note for a uapi header) and records the
# reason in its own header as well. An entry that matches nothing, or whose
# expression differs from the file's header, fails the test, so the list

column3: the generated kernel topic carries this header byte for byte; the tag becomes BSD-3-Clause (the body is BSD text) when the topic is amended and every kernel line regenerated with the next kernel rebuild
